stage_content.content: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels, powered by pedaling. It is a popular mode of transportation and recreation.
Bicycles have several features, including a frame, wheels, pedals, and a seat. They come in different types, such as road bikes and mountain bikes.
When describing the features of a bicycle, consider its design, materials, and functionality. This will help you understand its purpose and how it is used.
